title: Integral after composing with a separated morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $g\circ f$ is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and $g$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $f$ is integral.

mathlib_searches.query: if the composite f ≫ g is integral and g is separated then f is an integral morphism of schemes

mathlib_searches.results: Integral.lean:86 lemma of_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIntegralHom (f ≫ g)] [IsSeparated g] : IsIntegralHom f; :89 comp_iff [IsIntegralHom g] : IsIntegralHom (f ≫ g) ↔ IsIntegralHom f

mathlib_match.how: exact: of_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIntegralHom (f ≫ g)] [IsSeparated g] : IsIntegralHom f (Integral.lean:86; f ≫ g is g∘f); IsIntegralHom and IsSeparated are the matches of def-weil-finite-integral-morphism and def-weil-proper-morphism
